Yes, you're eligible. Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase and haven't used any benefits, and at 10 days you have about 4 days left, so I'd act soon.

The refund goes back to your original payment method, usually in **5-10 business days** for cards or **3-5 business days** for digital wallets. Alternatively, you can take instant Leafy store credit that never expires.

The policy I have doesn't say where to cancel Leafy Plus, so I can't give you exact steps. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to process the cancellation and refund before your 14 days run out. Would you like me to do that?
